visualCharacteristics: Horizontal carousel of product teaser cards in a coloured band, centred on init, with hover controls and edge-disabled arrows.
contentPattern: Band heading/copy row, then one row per product card (image, title, link).
usage: Product showcases on home and product pages. A start-shift-<n> class sets the initial track offset.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for horizontally scrolling product or item teasers.
